title: Zero-length iterated coupling
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\kappa$ be a probability law on $\Omega\times\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega^0\to\mathbb R$. The length-zero iterated coupling expectation is the product of the values of $f$ and $g$ at the unique empty tuple.
